name: office-worker-claude
description: A filing office backdrop where Claude panics as context fills, helpers join for subagents, and each tool call has its own pose

lite.title: Lite mode
lite.description: Keep Claude moving but stop the background motion (rain, papers, lamps, clock, plants) and the glass blur, to use less of your computer.

dim.title: Dim behind the chat
dim.description: How much the scene darkens behind the conversation in the middle, so the text is easier to read.
